title: Biblioteca Digital del Pensamiento Novohispano (BDPN)
notes: BDPN is the UNAM 'Biblioteca Digital del Pensamiento Novohispano' of 16th-17th century Mexican texts (astrological and astronomical discourse, letters, almanacs). The official site (bdpn.unam.mx) is online and states that the TEI files are distributed in the GitHub repository ficino2021/bdpn; the site licence is CC BY-NC 4.0 while the repository carries CC0. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this edition, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
institution: Universidad Nacional Autónoma de México (UNAM), Biblioteca Digital del Pensamiento Novohispano
